The '''Kegan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained one [[Star/Legends|sun]] and one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] member [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] once completed a [[Mission to Kegan|rescue mission]] in the Kegan system. Her success in the rescue mission resulted in her gaining prominence as one of the best [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="AdiTCG">{{TCG|set=Jedi Guardians|cardname=Adi Gallia (A)|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/JG/Adi_Gallia_A.webp?v=2}}</ref>
